core_categories: Medical Equipment; Hospital Beds; Stretchers; Carts; Casework; Architectural and Construction Services
specialty_focus: CME Corp is a national specialty distributor of healthcare and laboratory equipment, serving hospitals, clinics, and other healthcare organizations. It provides turnkey logistics, biomedical services, and equipment planning, delivery, installation, and ongoing service support. While it distributes a wide range of medical equipment, it does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
